claims.evidence: Photo 0 screen shows LG webOS home menu
No reference object, measurement, or box/label visible to confirm screen size

claims.claim: AI Smart TV with advanced features
claims.evidence: webOS home screen confirms smart TV platform, but 'AI' features and specifics are not shown

risks.risk: Actual screen size may be smaller than claimed 86 inches
risks.proof: Photo with a measuring tape across the screen diagonal, or a common object (door, person) for scale
risks.if_unproven: price as a mid-size TV, not confirmed 86-inch class

risks.risk: Model number may not match a genuine LG 86UA85006LA, affecting features/value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the back panel label or box sticker showing model and serial number

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracked panel, dead pixels, dents) not visible in demo-mode photos
risks.proof: Photo/video of the TV powered on showing full picture quality and a close-up of screen edges and back panel

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional remote, power cable, or wall mount bracket
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together with the TV
risks.if_unproven: price as TV only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Soundbar and small streaming box visible may or may not be included in the sale
risks.proof: Seller statement with photo confirming inclusion, or separate photo if excluded
risks.if_unproven: price TV alone, exclude soundbar/box value

risks.risk: Unknown age, usage history, or prior repairs affecting lifespan
risks.proof: Photo of purchase receipt, warranty card, or settings page showing usage hours if available
risks.if_unproven: price as used with unknown history, no warranty assumed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the back panel label showing exact model and serial number
Photo with a tape measure or common reference object across the screen diagonal
Video of the TV powered on with live content (not demo mode) showing full screen clarity and no dead pixels or lines
Photo of all included accessories: remote, power cable, wall mount bracket
Clarification and photo confirming whether the soundbar and streaming box are included in this sale
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an LG smart TV in working condition (webOS menu visible), so it can be priced, but size, exact model, panel tech, condition, and accessory inclusion are all unverified and must be priced at worst case until proof is provided.
